# Sarran AI Solutions LLC

> Orlando-based AI consulting practice building practical voice agents, workflow automation, AI readiness plans, and AI-integrated websites for US businesses.

## Services

- [AI Assessments and Strategy](https://www.sarranai.com/ai-readiness-assessment.html): Explains the 45-minute discovery call, ranked opportunity plan, verified tool costs, and four-day starting plan.
- [Intelligent AI Voice Agents](https://www.sarranai.com/ai-voice-agents.html): Covers inbound answering, caller qualification, calendar booking, approved outbound follow-up, transcripts, and reporting.
- [AI-Integrated Web Development](https://www.sarranai.com/ai-web-development.html): Describes performance-focused websites with targeted AI qualification, routing, and answer capabilities.
- [Workflow and Task Automation](https://www.sarranai.com/workflow-automation.html): Covers scheduled and event-triggered automation for intake, data movement, reporting, invoicing, and follow-up.

## Process and Standards

- [Assessment Process](https://www.sarranai.com/#how): Describes discovery, analysis, the written plan, and the final walkthrough completed in about one week.
- [Production and Governance Controls](https://www.sarranai.com/#trust): Explains human approval gates, least-privilege tool access, data minimization, logging, and production cost controls.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.sarranai.com/#faq): Provides direct answers about assessments, voice-agent capabilities, delivery time, service area, and sensitive actions.
